item.title: "One of the most demanding matches I have played": Carlos Alcaraz wins epic 5:30 hour showdown with Zverev
item.description: Carlos Alcaraz has reached Australian Open final for the first time after an epic showdown with Alexander Zverev that lasted for 5 hours, 27 minutes, the longest semi-final in the Australian Open history. Alcaraz took the initiative winning the first two sets, but Zverev rallied to win the other two, all of them in tie-breaks.
